chart.title: {market}, {tf}, {bars} candles
chart.fallback: Live candles could not be loaded ({reason}). Showing sample data instead.
chart.source: Spot prices from Binance. Your broker's prices will differ.
chart.pan: Drag to move back in time. Double click to return to the latest candle.
stats.title: Backtest
stats.assumptions: Simulated on a 10,000 account with the whole balance in each trade and a 0.05% cost per side. Past data, not a forecast.
stats.few: Only {n} trades: too few to tell skill from luck. Try a lower timeframe or looser conditions.
stats.none: No trades on these candles: the entry condition never happened.
stats.indicatorOnly: Add a Buy or Sell block to turn this into a strategy and see how it would have traded.
stats.error: The engine could not run this strategy: {msg}
settings.title: Risk and lot
settings.symbolHint: Fill it in only if your broker names it differently (XAUUSD.m, GOLD...).
warn.needsNumber: A condition is connected where a number is expected. It was ignored.
warn.logicNeedsTwo: An AND/OR block needs two conditions connected. It was left out.
warn.actionNeedsCondition: An order block has no condition connected, so it would never fire. It was left out.
warn.rrNeedsStop: A target measured in stops needs a stop. Pick a stop or another kind of target.
error.loop: Two blocks feed each other in a circle. Remove one of the connections.
error.empty: Nothing to build yet. Connect a condition to an order, or draw something on the chart.
code.title: Pine Script v6
mt5.title: Send it to MT5
mt5.intro: The script already carries the message SignalForge needs. Four steps:
mt5.step1: Copy the script, open the Pine Editor in TradingView, paste it and press Add to chart.
mt5.step2: Create an alert. Condition: this strategy, with the option Order fills only.
mt5.step4: Tick Webhook URL and paste the webhook from your SignalForge dashboard.
mt5.sample: What MT5 receives on a buy:
mt5.note: TradingView only sends webhooks on its paid plans.
mt5.needStrategy: Add a Buy or Sell block first: without orders there is nothing to send.
mt5.stopNote: The stop and the target live in TradingView, not at your broker: when one is hit, TradingView sends the close.
footer.engine: Runs on PineTS and React Flow.
footer.disclaimer: Not affiliated with TradingView; Pine Script is a TradingView trademark. A backtest shows the past, not what will happen. Trading carries risk.
